Name: Bigger Craftables
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Bigger Craftables[/b] lets content packs add big craftables bigger than one tile!

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
[b][size=3]For players[/size][/b]
This mod does nothing on its own; you need to install content packs by unzipping them into your Mods folder. See [i]Requirements[/i] > [i]Mods requiring this file[/i] above to find content packs.

[b][size=3]For mod authors[/size][/b]
See the optional downloads for an example content pack.

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

[b][size=5]See also[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/BiggerCraftables/docs/release-notes.md#release-notes]Release notes[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods]Source code[/url]
[/list]
